_readme: Source of truth for the ServiceNow Store apps shown on the site. Hand-edit the `app` blocks. The `store` blocks are written by scripts/store-sync.mjs from the live Store listing; do not edit them by hand. Order of the spotlight: the listed app with the newest store.certified_at wins; ties by `order`.

apps.name: Update Center
apps.summary: Manage store application updates across your entire ServiceNow estate from one dashboard: scan, review and install in guarded waves, with production-grade safety controls.
apps.problem: Platform teams that run more than one instance lose hours every cycle keeping store apps current: log in to each instance, open Application Manager, click Update one at a time. Updates get skipped, environments drift, and production changes land without proof from lower environments.

features.title: One screen, every instance
features.text: Register each instance once. Update Center scans them all and lists every available update with summary, release compatibility, dependencies, vendor and full version history.

features.title: Production stays locked
features.text: Production is locked until you enable it, and a version must be proven on a sub-production instance first. Blocked apps never slip into bulk updates.

features.title: Guarded waves
features.text: Upgrade one app, a selection, or everything. Large selections split into capped waves that submit themselves as each wave completes.

features.title: Self-healing
features.text: A background engine tracks installs to completion, recovers stalled submissions, promotes queued waves and runs a daily scan.

features.title: Enterprise credentials
features.text: Remote instances authenticate with Connection & Credential aliases or OAuth 2.0 profiles. No passwords in application tables.

features.title: Rollback id on every batch
features.text: Every batch records its rollback id, so you can see what changed, where and when, and back it out with proof.

sections.title: See the whole estate at a glance.
sections.text: Per-instance progress bars show the fleet marching to 100%. Filter by instance, vendor or state, and open any app for its full history.
bullets: Update inventory enriched from the app repository
Blocked updates shown with the vendor reason
sections.alt: Managed instances view with per-instance progress bars

sections.title: Safe by default, flexible when you need it.
sections.text: You decide how aggressive each environment can be. The defaults protect production.
bullets: Proven-on-sub-prod gate before production accepts a version
Capped wave size, automatic queue promotion
sections.alt: Settings page with production lock, sub-production proof gate and wave size guardrails

sections.title: Every update on the record.
sections.text: Each install is tracked to completion with its state, timing and rollback id, so change reviews have evidence instead of screenshots.
bullets: Per-app update records: available, submitted, updated, failed
sections.alt: Update records list showing the state of each application update

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Get Update Center from the ServiceNow Store and install it on your hub instance.

steps.title: Register instances
steps.text: Add each instance with a Connection & Credential alias or OAuth 2.0 profile.

steps.title: Scan
steps.text: Run a scan, or wait for the daily one. Review every available update.

steps.title: Update in waves
steps.text: Update one, some or all. Production stays locked until you say so.

apps.hero_alt: Update Center dashboard listing every instance and the store application updates available on each

apps.name: Azure Inventory
apps.tagline: Know every Entra app registration before its secret expires.
apps.summary: Inventories Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) app registrations, their client secrets and certificates into ServiceNow, with expiry tracking, ownership and advance renewal tasks.
apps.problem: Teams find out an Entra client secret or certificate has expired only when an integration, SSO login or automation breaks. Discovery and certificate tools don't see app-registration credentials, so expiry dates live in spreadsheets and calendar reminders, and nobody knows who owns each app.

features.title: Full app-registration inventory
features.text: Every Entra app registration, client secret and certificate pulled through Microsoft Graph into ServiceNow tables you can report on.

features.title: Expiry you see coming
features.text: Advance renewal tasks and dashboards for credentials expiring in 7, 30 and 90 days, before anything breaks.

features.title: Ownership that sticks
features.text: Each registration is tied to an owner and a service, so renewals land on the right team.

features.title: Read-only by design
features.text: The integration reads from Graph and never writes back to Entra. Credentials use ServiceNow Connection & Credential aliases.

features.title: CMDB-aware
features.text: App registrations become configuration items, so a credential outage maps to the services it affects.

features.title: Scheduled collection
features.text: A scheduled job keeps the inventory current with a full audit trail of every run.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Install Azure Inventory from the ServiceNow Store.

steps.title: Connect Graph
steps.text: Add a read-only Entra app registration through a Connection & Credential alias.

steps.title: Collect
steps.text: Run the first collection, or wait for the scheduled one.

steps.title: Act on expiry
steps.text: Work the renewal tasks from the dashboard before anything expires.

apps.name: Domain & Certificate Inventory
apps.tagline: Every domain and certificate you own, in your CMDB.
apps.summary: Pulls your registered domains, DNS and TLS certificates from your registrar into ServiceNow, with expiry tracking and renewal tasks.
apps.problem: Domains and certificates are bought by different people over years and tracked nowhere. The first sign of an expired one is a site that stops loading.

features.title: Domain inventory
features.text: Every registered domain with registrar, auto-renew flag, nameservers and expiry.

features.title: Certificate inventory
features.text: TLS certificates with issuer, subject names and expiry, mapped to the domains they protect.

features.title: Renewal tasks
features.text: Advance tasks for domains and certificates expiring soon.

apps.name: Contracts & Procurement
apps.tagline: Intake to purchase order, with a real approval chain.
apps.summary: A source-to-pay application for ServiceNow: procurement intake, budgets, contracts, approval rules, supplier channels and Amazon Business punchout.
apps.problem: Purchase requests arrive by email and chat, approvals happen in threads, and finance reconciles after the fact. Nobody can show who approved what, against which budget.

features.title: Guided intake
features.text: A record producer that captures what is being bought, for whom, and from which budget.

features.title: Approval rules
features.text: Decision tables route each request through the right approvers by amount, category and budget.

features.title: Contracts and budgets
features.text: Contracts, budgets and suppliers as first-class records tied to every request.

features.title: Supplier channels
features.text: Amazon Business punchout and supplier channels so the order goes out the moment it is approved.
